summary: AIM ImmunoTech Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement of common stock and warrants. The company agreed to issue 7,519,351 shares at $0.325 per share for gross proceeds of ~$2.4M, plus warrants to purchase up to 15,038,702 shares at $0.325, subject to stockholder approval. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. The filing is routine financing with no change of control, activist campaign, or strategic review.
